$comment: VAPI function tools. All point at the edge worker (onboarding rewrites the host per environment); timeouts are 3 s and the edge answers within 2.5 s; the edge decides whether to answer from Postgres directly (hot path) or forward to n8n. Tenant is resolved from call.phoneNumberId / call metadata, NEVER from tool arguments. Keep descriptions specific: the LLM picks tools from them.

function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Verify the caller's identity before discussing account, medical, or appointment details. Ask for last name and the last four digits of the phone number on file, or ZIP code if the caller doesn't know it.

zip.description: Postal or ZIP code, if phone_last4 unavailable.

messages.content: One moment while I check that.
Still checking, thanks for your patience.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Find open appointment slots. Use when the caller wants to book or reschedule. Returns up to three speakable options.

earliest_date.description: ISO date; resolve relative dates like 'next Tuesday' against today's date in the system prompt.

messages.content: Let me look at the schedule.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book a slot previously returned by check_availability. Only call after the caller explicitly confirms the date and time.

messages.content: I wasn't able to complete that booking.

function.name: request_opt_out
function.description: Caller asked not to be called again (e.g. 'stop calling', 'remove me', 'do not call'). Call immediately; no confirmation question needed.

function.name: log_callback_request
function.description: Record that the caller wants a callback from staff about a topic you can't handle. Runs in the background.

function.name: transfer_to_human
function.description: Transfer to a staff member when the caller asks for a person, the request is out of scope, a tool fails, or there is an emergency.

tools.$comment: Empty destinations => VAPI sends `transfer-destination-request` and the edge returns the tenant's on-shift number (business hours aware).

function.name: end_call
function.description: End the call after the caller's needs are met or after an opt-out is confirmed.
